evidence.excerpt: The paper's strongest claims about practical viability and 'approaching any quantization level' are overstated and not fully supported by the evidence. The theoretical guarantee in Appendix A concerns matrix reconstruction in Frobenius norm for a safeguarded algorithm, which is not proven to be the same as the practical algorithm used. More importantly, this guarantee does not directly translate to end-to-end model accuracy. The sole end-to-end result (Qwen3.5-4B on wikitext-2) shows a non-trivial perplexity gap to bf16 ($10.10$ vs $9.78$) and even to standard k-quants (Q4_K at $10.02$), indicating that at the system level, the method is not yet competitive on a perplexity-vs-bpw basis.
